text:
mira: noticing increased mTLS client rejections after the infra RBAC rename last night. rates up in us-west-2 and eu-central.

ben: which rename?

mira: we renamed the SA annotation key from `keystore.caller` -> `keystore.caller_id` as part of tidy-up at 23:45 UTC. rolled via infra-config-2026-03-19.

harpreet: oh. that annotation is used by the keystore-proxy to map caller -> KMS principal. if it's missing, HSM keys will reject Decrypt.

ops-bot: rollout infra-config-2026-03-19 applied to clusters: us-west-2, eu-central (author: ben).

mira: sample proxy log from us-west-2-ingress-A:
```
2026-03-20T00:12:09Z ERROR tls: client cert mapping failed: lookup annotation keystore.caller -> not found
proxy: KMS HSM Decrypt error: IAM Deny (principal: ) keyVersion: projects/rdw-hsm/locations/us/keyRings/rw/cryptoKeys/proxy-enc/versions/5
```

ben: confirm audit shows Decrypt denies with blank actor?

harpreet: yes. cloud audit shows protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail empty for those requests between 00:11-00:18 UTC.

sasha: impact? any partners blocked?

mira: ceased traffic for two legacy partner integrations (downtime ~6m each). also triggered compliance alert for missing audit identity in eu-central (sensitive regs).

ben: short-term mitigation: revert the annotation rename in infra-config for ingress service accounts, roll canary only in eu-central first. then prepare proper migration mapping in proxy code to accept both keys.

harpreet: agree. also we should modify our KMS policies to accept a fallback signed assertion for the proxy until migration completes (narrow scope).

mira: created quick revert patch:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: ingress-proxy-sa
  annotations:
    keystore.caller: "projects/rdw/serviceAccounts/ingress-proxy"
```
rolling to eu-central canary now.

ops-bot: canary start -> eu-central (2 pods).

ben: longer-term fixes:
- proxy: accept both `keystore.caller` and `keystore.caller_id` annotations for 30d grace
- infra: add an automated preflight that verifies required annotations exist before rollout
- security: add an alert for any KMS.Decrypt audit entry missing principalEmail
- compliance: ensure audit-export retention >= 1y for eu-central region (PR incoming)

sasha: vuln note: HSM key rotation happened yesterday too (v5). confirm that key version mismatch isn't the root cause?

mira: we checked key versions; Decrypt call used correct version 5 and succeeded once annotation was restored. so root cause = annotation rename.

harpreet: I'll patch proxy to log both annotation keys and fall back to token-introspection if missing. will add unit test.

ben: can we add a smoke check to pipeline: attempt Decrypt with a test wrapped key and assert principalEmail present in audit?

mira: yes, add to post-deploy smoke: call KMS.Decrypt + fetch audit entry. sample gcloud snippet:
```
gcloud kms decrypt --location=us --keyring=rw --key=proxy-enc --ciphertext-file=/tmp/ct --plaintext-file=/tmp/p
# then query audit logs for principal
```

sasha: canary healthy in eu-central after revert, audit principal populated. proceeding to us-west-2 rollout.

ops-bot: rollout complete -> us-west-2 (author: ben).

mira: filing follow-ups: ticket-2341 (proxy dual-key support), ticket-2342 (preflight annotation checker), ticket-2343 (audit missing-principal alert), ticket-2344 (retention PR).

ben: thanks. lesson: small annotation changes can have big identity consequences when plumbing touches KMS/HSM. :facepalm:
